post.title: Why Picturing Your Dream Can Stop You Chasing It #shorts
post.description: What's the first obstacle to your dream? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who's manifesting instead of applying. Leo pictured the dream job so clearly, then never applied. In 'Positive Fantasies About Idealized Futures Sap Energy' (Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, 2011), Heather Barry Kappes and Gabriele Oettingen had people imagine an idealized future, like a perfect week or doing brilliantly, while others imagined a more questioning or neutral version. The positive dreamers' energy dropped, measured by lower systolic blood pressure and by how energized they said they felt, and people who dreamed about an ideal week reported getting less done a week later. Daydreaming isn't the enemy: Oettingen's fix, mental contrasting, is to picture the dream and then the first real obstacle. #psychology #shorts #motivation #overthinking #goals
